hints.title: Coordinate Mapping
hints.text: Each letter corresponds to coordinates r = (ord(c) - ord(a)) // 5 and c = (ord(c) - ord(a)) % 5.

hints.title: Special Character Boundary
hints.text: The letter z is alone on the last row at (5, 0). Stepping off the board is invalid.

hints.title: Direction Ordering Precedence
hints.text: To avoid moving into empty space near z, always perform leftward and upward moves before downward and rightward moves.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Moving down before left can step into an invalid board location when navigating towards the letter z.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Ordering directions as Up/Left before Down/Right ensures safe traversal without extra search overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize the non-rectangular boundary edge case at the bottom row letter z.
complexity.notes: Every target letter must be followed by the select character !.
